title: 第25章 忽悠成功准备出发第26章 失忆醒来
slug: 系统绑错人龙套被迫走主角剧本
content_zh:
“师兄你说的确实没错，但...但让我去偷窥...师尊她沐浴...我...我实在是...”
“下不了决心？那就对了！”
龙涛语气带着赞许，“你要是一口答应，我以后反而得离你远点！
关键是踏出这一步的勇气和念头！
再说了，你以为真能看见什么？浴房里水汽白茫茫一片，能看清个影子就不错了！
重点是...只要你敢动这个念头，迈出这一步！
那股被压抑已久的‘雄’之气，自然就会被这股冲破禁忌的刺激感点燃！
到时候目的也达到了！”
龙涛这番重在参与的论调，打通了南宇辰的纠结，他眼神逐渐变得坚定，
“龙师兄！
我明白了！
你说得对！
我在漱月峰安逸得太久，被师姐们保护得太好了，不能再这样下去了！
我也得...偶尔做一回坏孩子！”
南宇辰话音落下的瞬间，整个屋子极其轻微却清晰地晃动了一下！
，虽然很轻，但龙涛还是奇怪得问了句，
“这浮空岛也会地震的吗？”
“不可能，多半是某人修炼功法或者炼器炼丹吧，偶尔也会来这么一下的。”
然而此刻，这个晃动的根源处，苏木芷周身灵力激荡，正拼命想要离开屋子，两名筑基师妹自然是拦不住，全靠帘幕后明烛真人悄然释放的一道无形威压，才死死将她按在原地！
“师尊！

您别拦我了，宇辰他...会被那那混蛋给毁掉的！
他在教唆宇辰！”
“木芷！”
明烛真人的声音依旧清柔，却带着不容置疑的威仪，“你已是金丹修士，为一练气小儿的胡言乱语便如此失态，传出去成何体统？若让宇辰知晓我们一直在听着，你猜他又会如何看你？”
听师尊这么一说，苏木芷也冷静了下来，正还想说些什么，小师弟的声音又再次传了过来。
“龙师兄，你为什么...要帮我这么多呢？偷窥...师尊什么的，你的风险也很大吧，到时候被发现的话，我顶多被重罚，你可能会...”
龙涛闻言，脸上闪过一丝极其复杂的情绪。
他沉默了片刻，再开口时，声音里少了几分之前的虚伪和煽动，多了些难以言喻的真诚，
“唉...这也算是我的一种寄托吧。”
他扯了扯嘴角，露出一个自嘲的笑，“小时候，我也曾不知天高地厚，总觉得自己是个被埋没的天才，幻想着有朝一日能被明烛真人看中，收为弟子。
结果呢？我乃庸才一个，真人连正眼都不可能给我一次，可你小子...偏偏就达成了我这辈子都不敢想的夙愿。”
他的语气带着深刻的落寞，却也坦率无比。
“认识你之前，说实话，我也嫉妒你，但那次在无风崖你救我后...我才发现你就是个单纯到有点傻气的家伙，心里干净得像块纯净琉璃，就想着能帮你就帮你一下吧，你这样的人站在明烛真人身边，甚至未来能成就一番大道，总比让那些仗着有点天赋就目中无人、心术不正的混蛋得势要好。
更何况...我们这些在后世连名字都无人知晓的废物，也希望能在世上留下点什么啊。”
龙涛这番半真半假、夹杂着私心与理想的独白说完，侦听虫也终于耗尽了灵力，啪嗒一声掉在了地上，结束了它的使命。
屋内一片沉默。
四位女修的心情都颇为复杂。
对那个姓龙的，恨意似乎没那么深了，但一种更深的警惕油然而生，此人绝不能让他再靠近小师弟！
不为别的，就冲他那说话的煽动力！
看看这才多久？几句话的功夫，就把她们最单纯的小师弟，忽悠得准备去偷窥师尊沐浴了！

“师尊...”
朱怀素试探着开口，“现在怎么办？要不先把那小子打晕了扔出峰去？省得他再撺掇小师弟。”
帘幕之后，一片静谧。
content_en:
"Senior brother, what you said is indeed correct, but...but let me peek...Master, she is bathing...I...I really..."
"Can't make up your mind? That's right!"
Long Tao's tone was full of approval, "If you agree right away, I will have to stay away from you in the future!
The key is the courage and thought to take this step!
Besides, what do you really think you can see? The water vapor in the bathroom is completely white, it would be nice to be able to see a clear shadow!
The point is...as long as you dare to think about it, take this step!
The 'male' spirit that has been suppressed for a long time will naturally be ignited by the excitement of breaking through taboos!
By then the goal has been achieved! "
Long Tao's emphasis on participation cleared up Nan Yuchen's tangle, and his eyes gradually became firm.
"Senior Brother Long!
I understand!
You are right!
I have been at ease in Shuyue Peak for too long and have been protected too well by my senior sisters. I cannot continue like this!
I have to... be a bad boy once in a while! "
The moment Nan Yuchen finished speaking, the whole room shook very slightly but clearly!
, although it was very light, Long Tao still asked strangely,
"Will this floating island also experience earthquakes?"
"Impossible. It's probably someone who is practicing martial arts or refining weapons and elixirs. He does this occasionally."
However, at this moment, at the source of the shaking, Su Mu Zhi's whole body was surging with spiritual energy, and she was desperately trying to leave the house. Naturally, the two Foundation Establishment Junior Sisters were unable to stop her. They relied on the invisible pressure quietly released by Master Mingzhu behind the curtain to hold her in place!
"Master!
Don't stop me, Yuchen... will be destroyed by that bastard!
He is instigating Yuchen! "
"Muzhi!"
Master Mingzhu's voice is still gentle, but it carries an unquestionable dignity, "You are already a Jindan monk, and you lose your composure because of the nonsense of a child practicing Qi. How can you spread it out? If Yuchen knows that we have been listening, what do you think he will think of you?"
After hearing what the master said, Su Mu Zhi also calmed down. Just as he was about to say something, the junior brother's voice came over again.
"Senior Brother Long, why are you... helping me so much? Peeping... Master or something, the risk for you is also very high. If you are discovered by then, I will be severely punished at most, and you may..."
When Long Tao heard this, extremely complicated emotions flashed across his face.
He was silent for a moment, and when he spoke again, his voice was less hypocritical and inciting than before, and more indescribable sincerity.
"Oh...this can be considered a kind of sustenance for me."
He twitched the corner of his mouth and showed a self-deprecating smile, "When I was a child, I didn't know the heights of the world. I always felt that I was a buried genius, and I dreamed that one day I would be noticed by Master Mingzhu and accepted as a disciple.
The result? I am a mediocre person, and it is impossible for a real person to even give me a proper look, but you kid... just fulfilled my long-cherished wish that I never dared to think about in my life. "
His tone was profoundly lonely, but also extremely frank.
"Before I met you, to be honest, I was jealous of you, but after you saved me that time at Wufengya... I realized that you are a simple and a bit silly guy, with a heart as clean as a piece of pure glass, so I just thought I could help you. It is better for a person like you to stand next to Master Mingzhu, and even be able to achieve great things in the future, than to let those arrogant and evil-minded bastards gain power based on their talent.
What's more... we trash, whose names are not even known in future generations, also hope to leave something behind in the world. "
After Long Tao finished his monologue that was half true and half false, mixed with selfishness and ideals, the listening bug finally exhausted its spiritual power and fell to the ground with a thud, ending its mission.
There was silence in the room.
The moods of the four female cultivators were quite complicated.
I don’t seem to have that much hatred for the man named Long.Deep, but a deeper vigilance arises spontaneously, this person must never let him get close to his junior brother again!
If not for anything else, just for the inciting power of his words!
Look how long it has been? In just a few words, their most innocent little junior brother was fooled into being ready to spy on Master taking a bath!
"Master..."
Zhu Huaisu said tentatively, "What should we do now? How about knocking that kid unconscious and throwing him out of the peak? We will save him from teasing our junior brother again."
Behind the curtain, there was silence.
